## ITemplateManifestEntry type

One embedded `.html` template entry of a static app manifest.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ITemplateManifestEntry = {
    key: string;
    template: string;
};
```

## Remarks

Collected by `collectHtmlTemplates` — only `.html` files are embedded; class-inline `static template` strings ride the page classes instead. Consumed by `_pageLoadsFromManifest` via `templateManager.compile(key, template)`<!-- -->.
